messages:
Sophie Carter: Kicking off Orbiton onboarding — quick sync doc and proposed timeline. Primary goals: get API integration live, p50 latency <1s on chat route, and the pilot group using embeddings for search. Stakeholders we have so far: Orbiton PM (Lena), Orbiton infra (Carlos), Redwood SE Tom Nguyen. Proposed 30-day plan below. Pls react with availability. TL;DR: kickoff Mon 2026-04-13 10:00 PT? :calendar:

Tom Nguyen: I can join that slot. Quick Q: will Orbiton be on Private (VPC) or Hosted initially? I need RBAC + peering details to plan infra work.

Ravi Patel: Recommend starting with an 8-bit quantized 2.7B for cost/latency balance. @Tom, if they're on private we'll need GPU quota info; otherwise hosted is straightforward. Also: do we have a sample prompt set from them?

Anya Li: I'll run enablement. Suggest two 1-hr workshops: API integration walkthrough and prompt engineering + evals. Week 2 looks good for the sessions.

Eleni Morales: Heads up — their contract auto-renews at month 6, so we should lock adoption KPIs now. Proposed KPIs: DAU, queries per user, embedding recall on pilot eval set. We should tie a renewal health checkpoint into day 45.

Sophie Carter: Draft success criteria to debate: 1) Production-facing integration handling >=500 requests/day; 2) p50 latency <1s for short-chat queries; 3) embedding recall >=0.78 on Orbiton pilot test set; 4) security checklist (VPC/KMS/audit) complete. Anything missing?

Tom Nguyen: For VPC we'll need Orbiton's network CIDR, KMS key ARNs, and a point of contact. I'll drop an infra checklist in the doc by EOD. Also please share a sample prompt set so I can simulate load.

Ravi Patel: Noted on fallback strategy — will configure auto-fallback to the 1.3B variant when queue depth or latency breaches thresholds. I'll also put together a rough cost estimate for 10k tokens/day and an ops runbook for cache warmup.

DeployBot: sandbox-orbiton environment provisioned: https://console.redwood/sandbox/orbiton — creds DM'd to Sophie. :white_check_mark:

Sophie Carter: Nice. Next actionable steps: 1) lock kickoff time and send calendar invite, 2) Tom to share infra checklist (EOD), 3) Ravi to post model profile + cost estimate (48h), 4) Anya to draft workshop slides (prior to week 2). I'll post a formal agenda and a shared doc link in this thread.

Anya Li: I'll draft the agenda now. Can someone add their tech owners and emails in the doc so I can invite them to the workshops?

Tom Nguyen: I'll add Orbiton contacts: Carlos (carlos@orbiton.com) and Lena (lena@orbiton.com) to the doc and grant view/edit as needed.

Eleni Morales: I'll create three calendar checkpoints (30/60/90) and a renewal-risk review at day 45. Will invite the renewal owner and the SEs.

Sophie Carter: Perfect. If no objections I'll lock the Monday 10:00 PT kickoff and send invites + agenda by EOD. :thumbsup:
